title: Fast A/B/n Testing: Exact Multi-Policy Comparison via Tree-Coupled Feedback Sharing
abstract: arXiv:2608.12831v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Online platforms increasingly compare many adaptive decision policies---ranking systems, recommendation algorithms, pricing rules, and language-model agents---while each reward-bearing interaction can be costly or risky. A direct A/B/n design gives each of $J$ policies its own horizon-$T$ trajectory and therefore uses $JT$ outcomes. We introduce Tree-Coupled A/B Testing (\TCAB), an exact feedback-sharing design for arbitrary history-dependent contextual-bandit policies. At each round, a predictable tree connects the current policy histories; every parent--child context--action law is maximally coupled, and one reward is shared within each component of matched tree edges. Every policy retains exactly its standalone finite-horizon trajectory law, even though the policies are deliberately dependent. If $D_{e,t}$ records a mismatch on tree edge $e$ at round $t$, the number of reward queries satisfies the pathwise identity $N(T)=T+\sum_{t,e

translated_title: 快速A/B/n测试：通过树耦合反馈共享实现精确多策略比较
translated_abstract: 在线平台越来越多地比较多种自适应决策策略——如排名系统、推荐算法、定价规则和语言模型代理——而每次带来奖励的交互都可能代价高昂或具有风险。直接的A/B/n设计为每个$J$策略分配其独立的时间范围$T$轨迹，因此使用$JT$个结果。我们引入了树耦合A/B测试（\TCAB），这是一种针对任意历史依赖上下文强盗策略的精确反馈共享设计。在每一轮中，一个可预测的树连接当前策略历史；每个父-子上下文-动作规律被最大程度耦合，并在匹配树边的每个组件内共享一个奖励。尽管策略被有意地设计为相互依赖，但每个策略仍精确保留其独立的有限时间轨迹规律。如果$D_{e,t}$记录在第$t$轮树边$e$上的不匹配，奖励查询次数满足路径恒等式$N(T)=T+\sum_{t,e}$
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为树耦合A/B测试（\TCAB）的新方法，通过树状结构共享反馈，在保持每个策略独立轨迹规律的同时，显著减少奖励查询次数，实现高效且精确的多策略比较。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Tree-Coupled A/B Testing (\TCAB), a novel method that shares feedback via a tree structure, significantly reducing reward queries while preserving each policy's standalone trajectory law for exact and efficient multi-policy comparison.
